newsitem.title: GREECE: INTRASOFT WINS 1.0BLN DRS SOFTWARE TENDER.
newsitem.headline: INTRASOFT WINS 1.0BLN DRS SOFTWARE TENDER.

text.p: Greece's software developer and systems integrator Intrasoft signed a software procurement deal worth 1.0 billion drachmas with Malta's Bank of Valletta, it said on Wednesday.
Intrasoft won the international tender competing against 14 information technology companies including IBM Denmark, Unisys U.K. and Australia's FNS, it said.
The Bank of Valletta is a commercial bank with a network of 50 branches.

Intrasoft will provide the completed software in 18 months. It is based on its integrated banking software Profits covering a wide range of banking operations including deposits, lending, capital flows, forex transactions, general accounting, securities and other support applications, it said.
The new system will be installed on an open Unix platform using a client server architecture.
Shares of Intrasoft gained 163 drachmas to settle at 2,203, up 8.0 percent on heavy volume of 120,300 shares. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
